stops.name: Karwendel
stops.detail: You have to be fit to climb the 2,106 metre high Mondscheinspitze. Mountaineers are rewarded with a magnificent view of the Karwendel and Rofan mountains, the Venediger group and the Zillertal Alps. Nearby, ibexes may even leap past.
